blocks.x: CPG brands compete on shelf, on shelf-image and on data: trade spend efficiency, retail execution truth, demand signal quality and now provenance claims. The brands that win industrialize the sell-side data relationship with retailers. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in trade promotion management, demand planning, retail execution, with provenance claims close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
the places value leaks, CPG & Brands edition:

items: Retailer portals and EDI produce a patchwork; trade-spend ROI is estimated.
Promotions, distribution changes and retail signals confuse planners; forecast error compounds.
Sustainability/origin claims face EUDR/DPP scrutiny; evidence manual.
Retail-execution teams run route lists without shelf-truth priority; OOS persists.
TPM platforms resist modeling; spend decisions legacy.
Counterfeiting and diverted goods untracked; digital brand risk unmanaged.

blocks.x: The proof in CPG & Brands is a working system on a real workflow. These are the builds that go live:

items: retailer feeds harmonized for trade and demand analytics
promo uplift modeling with causal design
shelf-truth events routed to field teams
